color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Selected for light register (pageBackground #fcf7f1, luminance=247.8).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter-spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em on all headings). Maison Neue replaced with Manrope (Google Fonts CDN) — neutral geometric grotesque matching all-caps editorial precision.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling slower at intensity 2 (×1.3) — all transition and animation durations extended for a more languid, considered pacing.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened from 1920px to 1632px (−15%, intensity 2) — more editorial containment.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Section-specific breathing room at intensity 3 — section padding increased from 80px to 112px (+32px). All other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist D: Hover opacity at intensity 3 — opacity: 0.75 on hover for all links, nav links, buttons, and cards. Timing durations aligned to motion system (0.39s / 0.65s).

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 — 0.08em letterSpacing added to typography block. Reinforces the uppercase geometric formality of the type system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — one paragraph in Section 4 rewritten to add specific detail about physical materiality (cold-press paper, matte surface, couture lookbook register). concept_by_video.md generated fresh.
